S1 E6 — Angela's Scarf
Tom encourages Angela to become a style star, but he accidentally becomes a style star himself.

title: Talking Tom and Friends
description:
S1
Armed with tech gear, ideas and an unfailing sense of humor, Talking Tom and his friends are on a mission to reach stardom at all costs.

title: The Legend of Zelda
description:
S1 E1 — The Ringer
Link's only consolation for the boring duty of guarding the Triforce of Wisdom is keeping company with Princess Zelda, who does not feel the same way.

title: The Legend of Zelda
description:
S1 E3 — The White Knight
After Link and Zelda are ambushed by monsters, a prince from a neighboring kingdom saves the day, then sweeps the princess off her feet.

title: The Legend of Zelda
description:
S1 E4 — Kiss 'N' Tell
A damsel in distress from a dragon refuses help from Princess Zelda, but after being saved by Link, the lady rewards her hero with a kiss that turns him into a frog.

title: Totally Spies!
description:
S1 E2 — The New Jerry
The girls arrive at WOOHP to discover that Jerry has retired; in his place is Mac Smit, an attractive, charming, smart, cool, thirty-something who Sam develops a bit of a crush on.

title: Totally Spies!
description:
S1 E3 — The Get Away
Jerry surprises the girls by sending them on a vacation to Hawaii.

title: Totally Spies!
description:
S1 E6 — The Eraser
The girls go to Bora Bora to investigate the weird blob creatures that have come out from the ocean and sucked the memory out of the world's top ten scientists.

title: Atomic Betty
description:
S1 — Amulet of Shangri-La-De-Da
Betty is called upon to protect an amulet of the ancient bird-people of Shangri-La-De-Da, said to give the wearer unimaginable power; Purrsy gets stuck up a tree on Earth, enough to cause mass disturbia.
